ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: After ignoring all curved arrows, a benzene ring can be seen on the left side of the structure, and the benzene ring is connected to an oxygen atom; this oxygen atom is then connected to a carbonyl carbon, forming a PhO-C(=O)- phenoxy ester fragment. This carbonyl carbon is connected downward/right to the middle aliphatic carbon, next to which H is labeled. The middle carbon continues to connect to another carbonyl carbon on the right; this right carbonyl carbon is connected downward to an R substituent, and connected rightward to oxygen. H+ is separately labeled near the right oxygen. Reasoning: According to the specified method, represent the R substituent with the wildcard *, write from the acyl end connected to R as *C(=O), then connect the middle carbon C, then connect the left phenoxy ester carbonyl C(=O)O, and connect O to the benzene ring c1ccccc1, giving *C(=O)CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1. The separate proton in the figure is written as an independent fragment .[H+]. Therefore the complete SMILES is *C(=O)CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1.[H+].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure, ignoring all curved arrows: identify the left phenoxy ester group PhO-C(=O)-, the central carbon chain continuing to a second carbonyl, the R substituent on that carbonyl, and the separate H+ shown near the oxygen. Convert this connectivity into SMILES by starting at R as a wildcard *, writing the acyl carbonyl *C(=O), adding the intervening carbon C, then the phenyl ester carbonyl C(=O)O connected to benzene c1ccccc1. Add the separate proton fragment as .[H+].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：忽略所有弯箭头后，结构左侧可见一个苯环，苯环连到一个氧原子；该氧原子再连到一个羰基碳，构成 PhO-C(=O)- 的苯氧基酯片段。该羰基碳向下/右连接到中间脂肪族碳，该碳旁标有 H。中间碳继续连接到右侧另一个羰基碳；这个右侧羰基碳向下连有 R 取代基，并向右连有氧。右侧氧附近单独标出 H+。推理：按指定方法把 R 取代基用通配符 * 表示，从 R 所连的酰基端写作 *C(=O)，再接中间碳 C，然后接左侧苯氧基酯羰基 C(=O)O，并把 O 连到苯环 c1ccccc1，得到 *C(=O)CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1。图中单独的质子作为独立片段写作 .[H+]。因此完整 SMILES 为 *C(=O)CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1.[H+]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the line-angle structure: a phenyl ring attached through O to an ester carbonyl, followed by a methylene/alpha carbon bearing H and connected to another carbonyl whose substituent is labeled R; also note the separate proton label H+ and ignore the curved arrows.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the answer should be the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES conventions: represent the unknown R attachment as wildcard *, write the beta-dicarbonyl phenyl ester skeleton as *C(=O)CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1, and represent the separate proton as [H+], joining disconnected species with a dot.
